id_convention: All LLD-02 persistent entity/event/relationship identities use lowercase canonical UUIDv4 text from DomainIdFactory; descriptive/business values are never primary keys.

tables.name: reference_metadata
tables.purpose: self-describe the governed matching profile used by all persisted LLD-02 match keys
rules: Beta 1.0 initializes exactly one row with matching_profile_id='UNICODE_MATCH_V1'
startup/reference-service readiness verifies the stored profile is supported before matching queries or writes
future profile changes require a governed forward migration/reindex rather than changing this value opportunistically

tables.name: local_user_profiles
tables.purpose: singleton installation authentication-profile identity metadata; no credential material
columns: singleton_guard INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(singleton_guard=1)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: exactly one row after first-run setup; second insert rejected
password verifier/auto-login/data-key material are absent and belong to LLD-12
username change, if LLD-12 permits it, preserves local_user_profile_id

tables.name: customer_organizations
columns: lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: name/name_match_key are descriptive/matching evidence and are not unique
name_match_key must equal MatchingNormalizer(name) at every accepted write under reference_metadata.matching_profile_id
ordinary runtime exposes archive/reactivate, not destructive deletion of history-bearing rows
BEFORE DELETE trigger raises REFERENCE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN

tables.name: customer_org_identifiers
tables.purpose: history-preserving external Customer Organization identifier claims; Beta 1.0 supports Advanced Search Customer Account Code
columns: customer_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
identifier_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identifier_type IN ('customer_account_code'))
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','superseded'))
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
superseded_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK((lifecycle_state='active' AND superseded_at_utc IS NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NULL) OR (lifecycle_state='superseded' AND superseded_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: Customer Account Code is external matching evidence and never customer_org_id
value/match_key use exact UNICODE_MATCH_V1 normalized complete source value after field validation
a Customer Organization has at most one active customer_account_code claim
the same normalized code may have multiple active Customer claimants only after explicit reviewed conflict acceptance; matching remains ambiguous
ordinary assignment detects different claimants and requires review instead of stealing/merging
supersession preserves creation and superseding command identities

BEFORE UPDATE permits only one active->superseded transition setting superseded_at_utc/superseded_command_id while immutable identity/value/owner/created fields remain unchanged; superseded rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE trigger raises CUSTOMER_IDENTIFIER_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY

tables.name: contacts
columns: lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: equal names are allowed
name/name_match_key never authorize merge/global uniqueness
archived Contact remains historically queryable but excluded from new-active selectors
BEFORE DELETE trigger raises REFERENCE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN

tables.name: contact_channels
tables.purpose: reusable Contact communication/matching attributes; Beta 1.0 channel kind is email
columns: contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: channel_kind must exist in closed ContactChannelDefinition registry; Beta 1.0 includes email
value_text must pass ContactChannelPolicy storage validation; match_key uses exact governed MatchingNormalizer
equal normalized channel values are allowed and may produce ambiguity
channel identity is independent from Contact identity/authentication
BEFORE DELETE trigger raises CONTACT_CHANNEL_DELETE_FORBIDDEN
archived channel rejects further ordinary UPDATE; active->archived and active value/revision correction remain governed application transitions

tables.name: contact_affiliations
tables.purpose: explicit affiliation history under one continuous Contact identity
columns: contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
is_current INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_current IN (0,1))
closed_at_utc INTEGER CHECK(closed_at_utc IS NULL OR closed_at_utc>=opened_at_utc)
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK((is_current=1 AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (is_current=0 AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: at most one current row per Contact via partial unique index
changing affiliation closes previous current row and inserts new row in one UnitOfWork
BEFORE UPDATE permits only current->historical closure setting closed_at_utc/closed_command_id while immutable relationship/opening fields remain unchanged; historical rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE trigger raises CONTACT_AFFILIATION_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY
operational records preserve organization-at-use context in their owning domain rather than deriving history from current affiliation

tables.name: dispatch_locations
columns: address_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(address_mode IN ('standalone','site_derived'))
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
CHECK((address_mode='standalone' AND standalone_address_text IS NOT NULL AND length(standalone_address_text)>0) OR (address_mode='site_derived' AND standalone_address_text IS NULL))
rules: no Customer Organization ownership/preference column exists
Site relationship is owned by LLD-08 and not duplicated here
site_derived current address resolves through SiteDispatchAddressProvider; historical logistics snapshots belong to LLD-07
operation role never stored on location master
BEFORE DELETE trigger raises REFERENCE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN

tables.name: reference_lifecycle_events
tables.purpose: append-only reference lifecycle occurrence evidence distinct from application audit
columns: target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(target_type IN ('customer_organization','contact','dispatch_location'))
event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','archived','reactivated','descriptive_corrected'))
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: target uses immutable evidence identity rather than destructive FK so required history may survive future exceptional deletion authority
BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers raise REFERENCE_LIFECYCLE_APPEND_ONLY
accepted lifecycle events are referenced from corresponding LLD-01 audit event via audit_event_results

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_customer_org_active_identifier_type ON customer_org_identifiers(customer_org_id,identifier_type) WHERE lifecycle_state='active'
CREATE INDEX idx_customer_active_identifier_value ON customer_org_identifiers(identifier_type,match_key,customer_org_id) WHERE lifecycle_state='active'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_contact_current_affiliation ON contact_affiliations(contact_id) WHERE is_current=1
cross_module_schema_rule: LLD-08 creates/owns Site↔Dispatch Location relationship with UNIQUE constraints on both Site and dispatch_location_id; LLD-02 never adds site_id/customer_org_id shortcut to dispatch_locations.
verification: LLD-01 exact-schema verification must include all LLD-02 tables, partial/index coverage and protection triggers once the LLD-02 migration is accepted.
